messages:
maya-csm: Heads up  Nimbus onboarding caused an embeddings spike overnight, can we do a quick 15m triage to lock a short-term budget gate before the QBR? :wave:
owen-finops: I saw it in the billing stream. Tokens/day jumped from ~2k to ~44k for the cohort. If sustained
projected additional monthly spend ~ $5.4k. Recommend provisional daily cap + staged alerts. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
liam-embed-ops: Two immediate levers: enable batching on batch-embed endpoint (low risk) and add a feature-flagged soft daily cap. Adaptive caching next sprint. Soft-throttle will return 429 + JSON body and header so clients can react.
sarah-qa: I can run regression tests once you define the error contract. Please confirm response format (429 + {"code":"soft_throttle","allowed_remaining":N} + X-Soft-Throttle header).
maya-csm: Proposed quick config: daily_cap=50000; thresholds_pct=[50,80,95]; soft_throttle_pct=90; notify=[maya-csm,owen-finops]; override for CSM+PS. I'll add a mitigation slide to the QBR doc and notify Nimbus.
costbot: Policy created: nimbus-embed-3580246790. Notifying #customer-success and owen-finops@redwood.internal.
nora-customer: Thanks team  we'll send top-10 prompts and concurrency expectations by EOD and would appreciate batching enabled on the batch endpoint.
